# boe

> Provides functions to download and tidy statistical data published by the 'Bank of England'. Install with `install.packages("boe")`.

Version: 0.1.2. License: MIT.

## Functions

- [`boe_bank_rate()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_bank_rate.html): Download Bank of England Bank Rate history
- [`boe_consumer_credit()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_consumer_credit.html): Download consumer credit outstanding
- [`boe_exchange_rate()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_exchange_rate.html): Download sterling exchange rates
- [`boe_get()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_get.html): Fetch any series from the Bank of England Statistical Database
- [`boe_money_supply()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_money_supply.html): Download M4 money supply
- [`boe_mortgage_approvals()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_mortgage_approvals.html): Download mortgage approvals for house purchase
- [`boe_mortgage_rates()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_mortgage_rates.html): Download quoted mortgage interest rates
- [`boe_sonia()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_sonia.html): Download SONIA interest rate
- [`boe_yield_curve()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/boe_yield_curve.html): Download UK gilt yields
- [`clear_cache()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/clear_cache.html): Clear locally cached Bank of England data
- [`list_exchange_rates()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/boe/reference/list_exchange_rates.html): List available exchange rate currencies

## Documentation
